name: query-table-monorepo
description: Schema-driven data table — core, react, and ui packages.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/react && tsc -p packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui
